adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff shows an unconditional refresh-token exchange being performed before creating the `jsforce.Connection` (a `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` followed by updating the credential in Prisma). There is no expiry/"isExpired" check gating this refresh in the shown code, so it will execute on every `getClient()` invocation. Also, unlike other integrations modified in this PR, Salesforce does not use the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper (it only uses `parseRefreshTokenResponse`), meaning it will not route through `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when credential sync is enabled.
